summary: Parses control-point records from a structured file stream. Iterates a dispatch/read loop, extracting "ControlPoint" entries (3 coordinate dwords into v8/v9/v10) into a local buffer up to 20 points. With 4+ points collected, calls sub_457F90 to allocate/initialize the keyframe array. Returns 1 on parse failure or insufficient points, otherwise the sub_457F90 result.

operations.description: If ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v18, 384) reports no records on the first call, return 1 immediately.
Dispatch loop over the file stream; repeats while ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v18, 384) returns true.
sub_5651B0(v12) reads the next record from the stream buffer; status 0 means data, 2 or 4 means end of stream.
When the read status is 2 or 4, break out of the dispatch loop (end of stream).
sub_565870(aControlpoint, &v8, &v9, &v10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0) parses a record matching the aControlpoint label, extracting 3 coordinate values into v8/v9/v10.
When a ControlPoint parses successfully and the collected count is below 20, store v8/v9/v10 as the next 3 dwords of the v19 buffer and increment the count.
After the loop, if fewer than 4 control points were collected, return 1.
sub_457F90(v11, v19, v2) allocates/initializes the keyframe array from the collected control points; its return value becomes the function result.
Returns 1 on early failure or insufficient points; otherwise returns the sub_457F90 result.

unresolved: Exact wire semantics of sub_5651B0 record status codes other than 0/2/4 not established.
